prompt:
Create a 2 minute 30 second instrumental discovery piece about planets tracing nested orbits. Around 88 BPM, D major, a gentle circular pulse rather than a march. Celesta, pizzicato, bassoon and soft woodwinds as separate orbital voices that occasionally align. Elegant and slightly playful. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no lyrics, no hummed melody-as-voice, no singing, no whispered speech. No heroic brass, no ticking-clock cliché, no trailer percussion.

[00:00–00:22] Celesta ostinato in a 3-against-4 pattern, dry and bright.
[00:22–01:00] Pizzicato joins on a slower orbit; bassoon states a round bass path.
[01:00–01:45] Woodwinds layer inner planets; a light shaker appears only when orbits briefly commensurate.
[01:45–02:30] Voices peel away until celesta remains, still circling.
